image_description: A close-up view of two black computer multimedia speakers standing upright. The central speaker is fully visible, featuring a rectangular enclosure with rounded corners, a grey fabric grille covering the upper driver area, and a solid lower section with a circular logo and brand text. A second identical speaker is partially visible on the right, and a third object (possibly a subwoofer or another speaker) is partially visible on the left.
